en: A vintage illustrated postcard showing four Ottoman-era men in traditional robes and large white turbans inside an interior with a green divan. One seated figure appears central and authoritative, with others standing or sitting around him, possibly in council. The style is colored lithography. Along the bottom in red and black print is French text, and there is also a small printed number at the lower right.
